## Wakt 1.0.8

### Commitment locks
Lock any block, or every block at once, for up to a year. While locked:
- it cannot be deleted,
- its unlock challenge is disabled (the block screen says so instead),
- website blocks ignore challenge unlocks at the DNS level.

Early unlock is your choice when locking. With it on, breaking the lock takes a 24-hour wait and then typing your commitment phrase exactly. With it off, nothing short of uninstalling Wakt ends the lock before its date.

### Private site list
Set a PIN in Settings to hide the names of blocked websites. Entries show as "Hidden website" and the DNS log asks for the PIN. Blocking keeps working while hidden, and the list re-hides whenever you leave the app.

### Speed
The website filter card and DNS log now show the average upstream lookup time and how many lookups were answered from cache, so you can see the filter adds no meaningful delay. The filter also remembers your network's own DNS servers across restarts instead of falling back to public resolvers.
